This 2025 Kia K5 GT-Line in Gray represents a sophisticated choice for drivers seeking a midsize sedan that balances performance with practical everyday functionality.

- 8-Speed Automatic transmission with AWD for confident handling in all conditions
- Navigation System for seamless trip planning and route guidance
- Heated Front Bucket Seats with dual zone automatic climate control
- Leather steering wheel and leather shift knob for refined interior touches
- Emergency communication system: Kia Connect (includes 1 year free trial)
- Sport steering wheel with telescoping and tilt adjustment capabilities
- 18" Gloss Black Machined Finish Alloy wheels
- Heated steering wheel for added comfort during cold weather driving
- Front fog lights and fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- Dual front and side impact airbags with knee and overhead airbags
- SiriusXM radio with 6 speakers and steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Power driver seat with remote keyless entry
- Speed-sensing steering and four wheel independent suspension
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control for enhanced safety
- Split folding rear seat and rear seat center armrest

The GT-Line trim elevates the driving experience with premium interior appointments and sport-focused styling. The heated front bucket seats provide substantial comfort, while the leather steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of refinement to daily commutes. The navigation system and SiriusXM radio keep you connected and entertained throughout your journey.

Under the hood, the sophisticated I4 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers an efficient balance of power and fuel economy. With highway fuel economy rated at 33 mpg and city performance at 24 mpg, this sedan handles the road with practical efficiency. The four wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering provide responsive handling characteristics that drivers appreciate in a modern midsize sedan.

Safety takes priority in this K5 GT-Line with comprehensive protection including dual front and side impact airbags, knee and overhead airbags, and an occupant sensing system. Electronic Stability Control works in conjunction with traction control and four-wheel disc ABS brakes to help you maintain command in various driving situations. The Kia Connect emergency communication system provides added peace of mind with one year of service included.

The exterior reflects the GT-Line's refined character with 18-inch gloss black machined finish alloy wheels, body-color bumpers, and power door mirrors with turn signal indicators. Auto high-beam headlights and front fog lights enhance visibility, while mud guards and carpeted floor mats protect against the elements. The Wolf Gray paint finish showcases a contemporary aesthetic that maintains visual appeal through the seasons.

This 2025 K5 GT-Line combines practical features, refined comfort, and thoughtful engineering into a sedan designed for drivers who value both substance and style. We invite you to experience how this vehicle's blend of performance, safety, and everyday convenience aligns with your automotive needs.

This 2024 Lexus ES 350 delivers refined performance and sophisticated comfort in a silver exterior that commands attention on the road.

- 3.5L V6 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission providing smooth acceleration and responsive handling
- Premium Package with heated and ventilated leather seats for year-round comfort

- Intuitive Parking Assist with automatic braking and rear cross-traffic alert for added safety

The exterior parking camera, intuitive parking assist, and parking support alert system give you visibility and control when navigating tight spaces or backing up.

With an EPA rating of 22 city and 32 highway miles per gallon, the ES 350 delivers balanced fuel efficiency without compromising performance. The responsive steering and well-tuned suspension make this vehicle enjoyable on both highway commutes and local drives. The trunk accommodates your cargo with protective all-weather liners and a convenient carpet mat.

This 2024 ES 350 represents the complete package—luxury, reliability, and practicality in one compelling vehicle. We invite you to experience this sedan firsthand in our showroom and discover why Lexus owners remain loyal to the brand.

- BMW Curved Display with Head-Up Display
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Heated Front Seats

The gray exterior presents a contemporary aesthetic that complements the vehicle's modern electric powertrain. Finished in Skyscraper Grey Metallic, this i4 eDrive40 delivers a refined appearance while the 19-inch bicolor wheels add visual distinction.

Interior comfort is a priority with premium features designed to enhance your daily driving. The heated front seats and heated steering wheel provide warmth during cooler months, while lumbar support in the driver's seat ensures proper ergonomic support during extended drives. Wireless device charging keeps your smartphone powered without cable clutter. The BMW Curved Display with head-up display technology puts essential information directly in your line of sight, allowing you to maintain focus on the road.

Parking and navigation capabilities make daily driving more manageable. The Parking Assistance Package includes Active Park Distance Control, Surround View with 3D View, and Parking Assistant Plus, which work together to simplify maneuvering in tight spaces. BMW Maps Navigation provides comprehensive route planning and real-time traffic information.

Entertainment and connectivity receive thoughtful attention throughout the cabin. The Hi-Fi sound system with 10 speakers delivers quality audio, while SiriusXM satellite radio with a 1-year Platinum Plan subscription expands your listening options. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Compatibility ensure seamless smartphone integration, and the Iconic Sounds Electric feature adds a distinctive audio signature to the electric driving experience.

Safety and driver assistance features contribute to confident, secure driving. Electronic Stability Control, four-wheel independent suspension, and speed-sensing steering work together to maintain composure in various driving conditions. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive occupant protection. The auto high-beam headlights adapt to driving conditions automatically, while the auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare during night driving.

If you're searching for a 2024 Tesla Model 3 Long Range for sale in Marietta, GA, this is a listing worth stopping on. Pristine Cars & Trucks, located in Marietta in Cobb County, has a 2024 Tesla Model 3 Long Range Sedan in stock with 48,509 miles — a compelling opportunity to get into one of the most advanced electric vehicles on the road today at a used price point that beats buying new.About This 2024 Tesla Model 3 Long Range AI Computer Self-Driving Computer 4 With just over 48,000 miles on the odometer, this 2024 Tesla Model 3 Long Range sits squarely in the early ownership window. For an EV — and for a Tesla specifically — that mileage is quite low relative to what the battery and drivetrain are built to handle. Tesla's Long Range trim is designed with range-conscious drivers in mind, and at this stage in its life, the battery is expected to be performing close to factory specification. The 2024 Model 3 received a significant refresh, bringing updated exterior styling, a redesigned interior, and improved hardware throughout — so this isn't just any Model 3. It's the Highland generation, Tesla's most polished version of this platform to date.

Whether you're commuting across Cobb County every day or making regular runs into Atlanta and back, this vehicle is sized and equipped for exactly that kind of real-world use.2024 Tesla Model 3 Long Range Performance and Engine The 2024 Tesla Model 3 Long Range is powered by dual electric motors — one at the front axle and one at the rear — delivering all-wheel drive traction and a level of performance that routinely surprises new Tesla owners. The Long Range AWD configuration produces over 340 horsepower with instant torque delivery from a standstill, capable of reaching 60 mph in approximately 4.2 seconds.

Because electric motors don't operate through a traditional multi-speed transmission, power delivery is seamless and linear through the single-speed fixed gear system. There are no gear changes, no hesitation, and no power interruptions — just smooth, immediate acceleration any time you press the pedal. In real-world driving, this translates to confident highway merging, effortless passing, and an overall experience that feels more responsive than most internal combustion vehicles at this price point.

Regenerative braking recaptures energy during deceleration, extending range and reducing wear on the physical brake components — a meaningful long-term ownership advantage.Tesla Model 3 Long Range Features and Interior The 2024 Model 3 Highland refresh brought a dramatically updated interior that addresses many of the criticisms of earlier generations. The cabin now features an ambient lighting system, improved sound insulation, and a revised rear touchscreen that gives back-seat passengers independent control over media and climate. The driver-facing layout is centered around a large front touchscreen that handles navigation, climate, entertainment, media, and vehicle settings.

Standard Long Range Highlights

The Long Range trim includes Tesla's Autopilot system standard, which provides adaptive cruise control, lane centering, and automatic emergency braking. Over-the-air software updates mean the car continues to receive new features and improvements after purchase — something no gas-powered vehicle can match. Premium audio, glass roof, wireless phone charging, and a minimalist but high-quality materials package round out the interior experience.

Cargo space is practical for a sedan, with both a traditional trunk and a front trunk (frunk) providing total storage that rivals many compact crossovers.Tesla Model 3 Reliability and Ownership Tesla's reliability reputation has matured significantly with the Model 3 platform. Early production vehicles had some fit and finish inconsistencies, but by the time the 2024 Highland refresh arrived, Tesla had resolved the majority of those concerns with tighter build tolerances and better material sourcing. The powertrain itself — electric motors and a fixed-gear transmission — has dramatically fewer moving parts than any combustion engine, which translates to fewer things that can break over time.

Owners consistently report low maintenance costs. Safety is built into every aspect of this vehicle. The comprehensive airbag system includes front dual, front side, knee, and overhead airbags working together with electronic stability control and traction control to help protect occupants. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and four-wheel independent suspension further enhance protection during unexpected situations.

This Black Edition S60 arrives ready for ownership with all-weather floor mats, a cargo tray, wheel locks, and a first aid kit included. The practical touches paired with the luxury appointments make this sedan an excellent choice for anyone seeking style, capability, and reliability in a mid-size sedan.

Electronic Stability Control, traction control, brake assist, and four-wheel anti-lock disc brakes work together to maintain control in demanding conditions. Low tire pressure monitoring and an occupant sensing system provide continuous protection.

The 2.5L four-cylinder engine with eight-speed automatic transmission delivers balanced performance with an EPA-estimated 27 mpg city and 38 mpg highway, making this sedan both responsive and efficient. Power steering, speed-sensing steering, and four-wheel independent suspension combine for confident handling and a smooth ride quality that makes every journey feel composed and controlled.

This 2024 Camry XSE represents Toyota's commitment to quality, refinement, and value. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this exceptional sedan firsthand and discuss how it can enhance your driving lifestyle.

  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians.   • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. This 2009 Maserati Quattroporte Base represents a distinctive opportunity to own a sophisticated Italian sedan that delivers commanding presence and refined performance.

- 4.2L V8 DOHC engine with 6-speed automatic transmission
- Grigio Granito Metallic exterior
- Poltrona Frau leather seat trim with heated front bucket seats
- Navigation system with rear parking sensors
- Bose infotainment system with 11 speakers, CD player, and DVD-Audio
- Bi-Xenon high intensity discharge headlights with headlight cleaning
- Power moonroof
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- 18-inch alloy wheels (front 8.5", rear 10.5")
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror and auto-dimming door mirrors
- Memory seat and power driver seat with power adjustable front head restraints
- Genuine wood accents throughout interior (dashboard, console, door panels)
- Sport steering wheel with steering wheel mounted audio controls

The thoughtfully appointed cabin reflects Maserati's commitment to luxury, featuring genuine wood trim throughout the dashboard, console, and door panels that complement the Poltrona Frau leather seats. The heated front bucket seats and comprehensive climate control system, including rear window defroster and front dual zone A/C, ensure comfort for all occupants. Memory seating and power adjustments allow the driver to personalize their position, while the telescoping and tilt steering wheel adds convenience.

Technology features support both entertainment and navigation, with the Bose infotainment system delivering quality audio through 11 speakers, CD player, and DVD-Audio capabilities. The integrated navigation system combines with rear parking sensors to assist during maneuvering. Remote keyless entry, garage door transmitter, and the security system provide both convenience and peace of mind.

The chassis and suspension deliver the composed handling expected from this platform. Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars works in concert with electronic stability control, traction control, and speed-sensing steering to maintain stability and control. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power. Safety features include dual front and front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and low tire pressure warning.

The exterior presents a commanding silhouette in Grigio Granito Metallic. Bi-Xenon headlights with automatic activation and headlight cleaning enhance nighttime visibility, while front fog lights provide additional illumination. The 18-inch alloy wheels are proportionate to the sedan's stance, and rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions.

This Quattroporte Base combines Italian design heritage with practical daily usability, offering an entry point into Maserati ownership for those seeking a vehicle that distinguishes itself through craftsmanship and engineering.

This 2009 Volkswagen Passat Komfort delivers reliable German engineering in a sophisticated sedan that handles today's driving demands with grace and efficiency.

- 2.0L 4-Cylinder TFSI Turbocharged engine with 6-Speed Automatic transmission
- Heated front bucket seats for comfort in any season
- Power moonroof for open-air enjoyment
- 8-speaker sound system with AM/FM radio and SIRIUS satellite radio
- AM/FM with 6-Disc In-Dash CD Changer
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- Remote keyless entry and illuminated entry
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Speed-sensing power steering
- Dual front and side impact airbags with anti-whiplash front head restraints
- 4-Wheel disc brakes with ABS
- 17-inch Monte Carlo alloy wheels
- Steering wheel-mounted audio controls
- Telescoping and tilt steering wheel
- Trip computer with outside temperature display

The Passat Komfort strikes an excellent balance between performance and fuel efficiency. The turbocharged 2.0L engine generates responsive power while achieving 19 city and 29 highway miles per gallon, making it practical for both commuting and weekend drives. The 6-speed automatic transmission with Tiptronic manual shift capability gives you control when you want it, combined with front-wheel drive stability.

Inside, this Passat prioritizes comfort and usability. Heated front bucket seats keep you warm during cold months, while the split-folding rear seat expands cargo flexibility. The V-Tex leatherette seating surfaces maintain a refined appearance without the maintenance demands of traditional leather. Attention to detail appears throughout with the leather-wrapped steering wheel, power-adjustable driver seat, and comprehensive gauge cluster featuring a trip computer and compass.

Technology and convenience features enhance your daily driving experience. The entertainment system provides multiple options with satellite radio access, a six-disc CD changer, and steering wheel audio controls. Power windows, power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, and variably intermittent wipers respond to changing conditions. The power moonroof adds an open-air dimension to your driving experience.

Safety received serious consideration in this sedan's design. Four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering provide confident handling, while electronic stability control and traction control work continuously. Dual front and side airbags, anti-whiplash head restraints, and ABS brakes create a comprehensive safety system. The occupant sensing airbag and low tire pressure warning add additional layers of protection.

With 68,435 miles on the odometer and Island Gray Metallic exterior paint, this Passat Komfort presents as a well-maintained example ready for its next chapter. The combination of practical features, solid engineering, and reasonable fuel economy makes this sedan a sensible choice for drivers seeking dependable transportation with European-inspired driving dynamics.
